rules._comment_1: Default deny. Before 2026-09-03 this database had no rules file and no auth in the client, so an unauthenticated GET on /teambench_new.json returned HTTP 200 with the full participant tree: names, institutional emails, chat transcripts and submitted code for the COUHES 7676 study.
rules._comment_2: The study frontend (human_eval/_backend_clone/src/firebase.ts) performs no authentication at all. Deploying these rules WILL break it until the client calls signInAnonymously() and the backend uses a service account. Deploy anyway: an open participant database is the more serious problem, and the study is not currently collecting.
